description.en: Full traditional Sundarakāṇḍa of the Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa (68 sargas). Source: public MIT-licensed digital transcription; not a critical-edition claim.

Not a claim of Baroda Critical Edition text. | te/kn/pa meanings: Devanagari HI transliterated to regional scripts (HI-equivalent stopgap after Google MT rate-limit); mr/gu/bn/ta/or/ml are true MT.
